label: A holder of another MOTION_1 moves it in some respect
paraphrase: OPEN analyst sense bridge from MOTION_3 to MOTION_1, attribution deferred: if f, distinct from x, presently actualizes x in respect r (holding, definition 6ab9a832), then f moves x (the First Way's MovesIn, read broadly as educing from potency to act, MOTION_1, definition a7904c82) in some respect. Strongest support: x's act in r is from f's present acting, so f is presently reducing x's potency to that act, which is the broad reading of moving in DISAMB-MOTION. Substantive objection, recorded: where holding only conserves an act that x already has, the DISAMB-MOTION resolution reads moving as eduction from potency to act, and continued possession of an act is not a new eduction; on that reading conservation is not MOTION_1 moving, and the bridge holds only if present conservation of a lackable act counts as continuous reduction of potency to act.
